messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — had a pilot convo with VectorApps, they want a low-latency "Performance Plus" microtier for real-time scoring. Asked for firm per-minute SLA + burst cushion. Need quick call: do we ship as a new paid tier, an add-on, or a reserved-only feature?
Devin Patel: TL;DR: prefer add-on for initial launch. Less product surface, easier rollback.
Sophia Li: Agreed on add-on. But we should define clear launch gates: 95th p50 latency improvement vs baseline, cost delta < 2x for typical gen workloads, and metric coverage in Console.
Jon Park: From finance: we need a floor price that keeps gross margin >= 55% at expected utilization. Also require a minimum commit for SLA eligibility (e.g., 3mo min).
Maria Chen: @Devin can you write short perf target bullets? @Jon what's acceptable margin if we offer limited promotional pricing for pilot customers?
Devin Patel: Perf targets draft: 1) p50 end-to-end latency <= 80ms for 256-token requests, 2) tail p99 <= 400ms under steady load, 3) sustained QPS scaling to 300 qps per instance without >10% latency uplift. Pilot tolerance: one missed SLO per month for first 3 months.
Jon Park: Promo margin: we can allow down to 45% for pilots if they sign 6mo commit and we get case study rights. No lower.
Sophia Li: Operational constraints: need routing flag in Smart Router, fallbacks to standard tier, and telemetry labels for PriorityLane usage + per-route cost breakdown. Also add a circuit-breaker if burst consumption exceeds contracted cap.
Maria Chen: UX question — do we surface Performance Plus as a toggle in Console or as a separate product card? Leaning toward a toggle under "Advanced routing / Priority lanes" so it's discoverable to existing customers.
Devin Patel: Keep it a toggle initially. Avoid new SKU proliferation. If pricing/behavior diverges later, split out a separate SKU.
pm_bot: PRD created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-489 "Performance Plus pilot" — owners: @Maria, @Devin, @Sophia. Automated checklist added. :white_check_mark:
Sophia Li: Contract constraints we should put in draft: 1) SLA add-on only for commits >= $5k/mo, 2) softcap burst up to 2x monthly commit billed at premium rate, 3) early termination fee = 15% remaining term value if < 3mo served.
Maria Chen: Good. Can we also include a usage cap override for platform teams during incidents (manual ops override with audit trail)?
Devin Patel: Yes — ops override gate exists in the router. Need a UI control + audit log event. I'll add to infra ticket.
Jon Park: For rollout: pilot (3 customers, invite-only) -> closed beta (20 customers) -> GA. Need to capture ARR uplift targets at each stage and telemetry to measure churn risk.
Maria Chen: Launch checklist (quick): 1) benchmarks validated (Devin), 2) billing meter and invoice samples (Finance/Jon), 3) Console toggle + billing UI copy (Design/PM), 4) SLA legal text draft + contract template (Legal/Sales), 5) observability tags & alerting (Eng/SRE), 6) pilot customers signed (Sales).
Sophia Li: I'll own observability & router flags. Will add canary config to eng-runtime repo and a tracing dashboard.
Devin Patel: I'll own benchmarks and ab test plan. Will post perf scripts and sample load configs in #eng-runtime.
Jon Park: I'll prepare pricing matrices for pilot vs GA and a promo approval path.
Maria Chen: Great — action items noted. Follow-up meeting Friday to finalize pricing and customer list. Please add any missing items here. :thumbsup:
